title: A bond graph-oriented method for assessment of failures in an aircraft hydraulic brake system
abstract: © 31st Congress of the International Council of the Aeronautical Sciences, ICAS 2018. All rights reserved.In the context of system failures analysis, the present work aims to demonstrate the benefits of working in a cohesive manner with two particular modeling techniques, a physical modeling-based computational software and the bond graph concepts, when identifying failure modes and assessing the impacts of typical failures in an aircraft hydraulic brake system. The brake system performs an important, safety-related function in aircraft operation.
